hero.title: Buy it by the yard or by the piece.
hero.description: Fabric vendors sell full pieces, cuts by the yard, or both. Pick how much you need and the price is worked out as you go.

use.title: Have it made into something
use.description: Found a fabric you love? Apply it to one of your studio designs, or to a customizable outfit from your wishlist that accepts your own fabric.
points: For a bespoke design or a customizable outfit
Switch back to the vendor's fabric any time

studio.title: Every vendor's fabric, in one place
studio.description: When you design in the studio, search fabrics from every vendor by name, material, pattern or colour. Not sure yet? Let the tailor choose.
points: Material, pattern and vendor on every swatch
Or leave it to your tailor

delivery.title: Sent straight to your tailor
delivery.description: When the fabric and the tailor are different vendors, checkout adds a delivery leg that takes the fabric straight to your tailor, with its own courier and dates.
points: Its own courier, price and arrival dates
No collecting and dropping off yourself

conversion.title: Start with the fabric.
conversion.description: Join the waitlist to buy fabric and have it made into something that's yours.
